'''Kiardi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]. He was distinguished by his jowly facial features and single eye. Kiardi was present at the [[Triton Besh]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] when [[Shandy Fanaso]] visited it.<ref name="DTATM" />
